gaps.sentence: The hotel offered ___ our room free of charge.
gaps.explanation: offer takes the to-infinitive: offered to upgrade.
fail takes the to-infinitive: failed to meet.

gaps.sentence: She can't afford ___ her car repaired this month.
gaps.explanation: afford + to-infinitive: can't afford to get.

gaps.sentence: They accused me of ___ the rules.
They're planning ___ the flat before selling it.
gaps.explanation: plan + to-infinitive (plan on + -ing also occurs informally): planning to redecorate.
Negative infinitive: promised not to be late — 'not' goes before 'to'.

gaps.sentence: The box was heavy enough ___ two people.
gaps.explanation: adjective + enough + to-infinitive: heavy enough to need.

gaps.sentence: Do you know how ___ this machine?
gaps.explanation: know how/what/where + to-infinitive: know how to operate.
